title: Ukraine's new Marichka AI targets the one layer of its war stack that Palantir still owns
summary: According to Colonel Yurii Kliat, head of Ukraine's Central Research Institute of the Armed Forces, Marichka centrally gathers battlefield information, automatically calculates the balance of forces and combat potentials, and estimates required resources and likely losses.
